translations.translatedText: # Friday 9.9.2022 (radio)

Queen Elizabeth has died. Events in Britain are being cancelled because of Queen Elizabeth's death. The Foreign Ministry in Helsinki is lit up with festive lighting in memory of Queen Elizabeth. The new chair of the Defence Committee is Antti Häkkänen. Summer has been record-warm in Europe. Weather forecast.
## Death of Queen Elizabeth
![Queen Elizabeth on 2 June 2022.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1005247631a305aa4297/1662661914)
Open image viewer
Queen Elizabeth II 1926 – 2022. Photo: Backgrid London LTD / AOP
The ruler of Britain, Queen Elizabeth, has died. Queen Elizabeth died on Thursday at Balmoral Castle in Scotland.

The queen was 96 years old. That is why on Friday 96 gun salutes were fired in London in memory of the queen. Church bells were also rung in memory of the queen. Elizabeth was queen for over 70 years.
Britain's new ruler is the queen's eldest son, Charles. King Charles has immediately begun his duties as king.
## Mourning period
![Salute squad for Queen Elizabeth II in London.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_116/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1005793631b44a9ad9af/1662731463)
Open image viewer
On Friday 96 gun salutes were fired in London in memory of the queen. Photo: AFP/Lehtikuva
In Britain many events have been cancelled because of Queen Elizabeth's death.

For example, English Premier League football matches will not be played at the weekend. Horse racing competitions have also been cancelled. Workers on Britain's railways and the post have called off a strike that was due to start at the weekend.
In Britain there is a 10-day mourning period because of Queen Elizabeth's death.
## Elizabeth remembered in Finland

![People brought flowers and candles in front of the British embassy on 9.9.2022.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5733,h_3224,x_15,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1005615631b1ce8cbbd0/1662722524)
Open image viewer
People brought flowers and candles to the British embassy. Photo: Kimmo Hiltunen / Yle
Many Finns have brought flowers and candles to the front of the British Embassy in Helsinki.
The embassy is also flying its flag at half-mast in memory of Queen Elizabeth.
The Finnish Foreign Ministry in Helsinki will be illuminated with festive lighting on Friday evening in memory of Queen Elizabeth.
## Chair of the Defence Committee

![Antti Häkkänen, MP from Mäntyharju, smiles at the camera at the opening of Kisala.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3745,h_2108,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-872690617a4f8e356e3/1635406620)
Open image viewer
The chair of the Defence Committee is now the National Coalition's deputy chair, Antti Häkkänen. Photo: Sari Ursin / Yle
Parliament's Defence Committee has chosen a new chair. The new chair of the Defence Committee is **Antti Häkkänen**. Häkkänen is also deputy chair of the National Coalition.
Häkkänen takes over the post from National Coalition chair Petteri Orpo, who had been chair of the Defence Committee since the spring.
In this electoral term the post of Defence Committee chair always belongs to the National Coalition, even though the chair changes from time to time.
## Record temperatures in Europe
![Riverbank cracking from drought on the Rhine river.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3000,h_1687,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-99684262ff8950ab7b7/1660914054)
Open image viewer
The Rhine river in Düsseldorf dried up in the summer. Photo: Sascha Steinbach / EPA
Summer has been record-warm in Europe. The EU's climate service has published statistics on the summer's temperatures. Last summer was warmer in Europe than has ever been measured before.

The temperatures in Europe were the highest in the measurement history in August. The temperatures were also the highest in the measurement history for the whole summer, that is, June, July and August.
Historically high temperatures were measured in many European countries in the summer. In many countries people have also suffered more from drought than before.
## The weather
![Saturday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12617979)
Open image viewer
Cloudiness varies on Saturday.

On Saturday the weather is dry across almost the whole country. In the north a little rain may fall. The sun shines in the south, and perhaps also in places elsewhere. The temperature is between 10 and 17 degrees.
